out.title: Installed
out.text: Nexus is running as an app on this device.

out.title: This is a saved file
out.text: Chrome cannot install a file from your storage. Installing needs the app version on an https address, once. After that it also works offline.
steps: Unzip Nexus-app and put the folder on a free host (GitHub Pages, or Netlify Drop which takes the folder as it is).
Open that https address in Chrome.
Tap the menu (three dots), then Install app. Or come back here and press Install.
Your data stays on each device. Move it with a backup file.

out.title: Needs https
out.text: Chrome only installs apps from https addresses. This one is plain http.
steps: Put the app on an https host, then open that address.

out.title: Install from the Chrome menu
out.text: Chrome has not offered an Install button here. That happens when the app is already installed, or the browser is not Chrome.
steps: Choose Install app, or Add to Home screen.

out.title: Ready to install
out.text: Chrome can install Nexus now. It opens in its own window, works offline, and can show a count on its icon.
